recommendation: Conduct targeted outreach to underserved populations for vaccination
implementation_steps: Conduct home visits to reach underserved populations
Track and link defaulters to vaccination services
Provide culturally tailored education about vaccines
Update contact information for hard-to-reach populations
Verify immunization records to support data quality
evidence_summary: CHW-led outreach interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in vaccination rates among underserved populations, particularly in communities with historical barriers to healthcare access.
citation: Effective Interventions to Increase Routine Childhood Immunization Coverage
